targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}')

SELECT customer_segment AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name = 'form_abandoned' AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM product_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name = 'rage_click_detected' AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT event_name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS count FROM product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT page_path, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name='page_view')::bigint AS page_views, ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'duration_ms')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE event_name='page_time_spent' AND metadata ? 'duration_ms'))::bigint AS avg_time_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name='form_abandoned')::bigint AS form_abandons, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name='rage_click_detected')::bigint AS rage_clicks FROM product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND page_path IS NOT NULL AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') GROUP BY page_path ORDER BY (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name='form_abandoned') + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name='rage_click_detected')) DESC, page_views DESC LIMIT 20

WITH base AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::numeric AS signup_started FROM product_analytics_events WHERE event_name='signup_started' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') ), done AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::numeric AS signup_completed FROM product_analytics_events WHERE event_name='signup_completed' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') ), login AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::numeric AS login_success FROM product_analytics_events WHERE event_name='login_success' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') ), cfeed AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::numeric AS capacity_feed_viewed FROM product_analytics_events WHERE event_name='capacity_feed_viewed' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') ), cdeal AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::numeric AS deal_completed FROM product_analytics_events WHERE event_name='deal_completed' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - ('${days}' || ' days')::interval AND ('${segment}' = 'all' OR customer_segment = '${segment}') ) SELECT b.signup_started::bigint, d.signup_completed::bigint, l.login_success::bigint, CASE WHEN b.signup_started > 0 THEN ROUND((d.signup_completed / b.signup_started) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS signup_conversion_pct, cf.capacity_feed_viewed::bigint, cd.deal_completed::bigint, CASE WHEN cf.capacity_feed_viewed > 0 THEN ROUND((cd.deal_completed / cf.capacity_feed_viewed) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS capacity_to_deal_pct FROM base b CROSS JOIN done d CROSS JOIN login l CROSS JOIN cfeed cf CROSS JOIN cdeal cd
